title: Adjust's Reset button was never wired, and mask to paint painted the default colour
description:
USER-REPORTED 2026-08-05, validating MPI-445 and MPI-439. Two confirmed regressions, one report that did not reproduce.

1. RESET IS A DEAD BUTTON on BOTH Adjust destinations. MPI-436 rewrote the commit row for two destinations and dropped the line resetBtn.on('click', _reset) on the way through. Nothing failed - the button rendered, went into _children and destroyed cleanly, it just did nothing when clicked, for two shipped cards. Proven dead and then proven fixed by clicking the real button in a mounted panel in Chromium.

2. MASK TO PAINT USED THE DEFAULT COLOUR. PaintManager.color is panel state: it only holds the user's colour once a paint-family tool has mounted and pushed it, and a canvas remount resets it to the module default. Converting from a mask tool - which is the normal way to reach the context menu - painted #e0446b instead of the picked colour. The fix reads the project's paint tool setting, the same source both colour pickers read and write.

3. APPLY DID NOT REPRODUCE. Driven end to end in Chromium - the real MpiToolOptionsMaskAdjust panel on a real MpiCanvas - Apply bakes correctly (paint ink 125676 -> 151892, slider returns to 0, preview torn down), and the same at manager level for both layers, and the panel's click handler does call applyPaintAdjust / applyMaskAdjust. Needs the user's symptom before it can be fixed: nothing happens, reverts, or wrong result.

UMBRELLA: MPI-440.
acceptance: Reset drops the pending Adjust preview and returns the sliders to zero, on BOTH the mask and the paint destination - clicked as a real button, not asserted from source alone
A guard test fails if any button in the commit row is mounted without a click handler - the failure mode that hid this for two cards

Convert mask to paint uses the colour the picker shows, resolved from the project's paint tool settings rather than from PaintManager.color, and works when the conversion is made from a mask tool with no paint tool ever mounted
The Apply report is either reproduced and fixed, or closed with the user's own confirmation that it works - it must not be quietly dropped because it did not reproduce here
